title: Activity labels and links
responsibility: Formats recorded activity timestamps, agent states, counts and commit navigation.

inputs.name: activityDisplay.agents
inputs.description: Registered agent roster with a working count; null means no agent has registered and the count is unknown. Only the working count affects this label, and unregistered agents are not counted.

inputs.name: commitHref.base
inputs.description: Prefix concatenated directly before the history route returned by consoleRoutePath. The function does not normalize separators.

inputs.name: commitHref.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier passed to the history route. This function does not validate its format.

inputs.name: commitHref.branches
inputs.description: Ordered branch names passed to the history route; only the first is used. An empty array passes null for the branch.

inputs.name: plural.count
inputs.description: Number printed before the word; only exactly 1 selects the singular form. Every other number selects the form with an appended s.

inputs.name: plural.word
inputs.description: Base word printed after the count; an s is appended unless the count is exactly 1. Irregular plural forms are not handled.

inputs.name: activityTime.iso
inputs.description: Timestamp string parsed by JavaScript Date. Valid dates are formatted in UTC to the day and minute; invalid input is returned unchanged, and offset-free strings can depend on the host timezone.

outputs.name: agentStates
outputs.description: Fixed display labels for the working, stale, gone, completed and failed states. The gone state is labeled Process ended.

outputs.name: commitHref
outputs.description: Base concatenated with the consoleRoutePath for the history view, using the commit and first branch or null. Route formatting is defined by consoleRoutePath.

outputs.name: activityTime
outputs.description: Valid timestamps become ISO UTC text sliced to YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, dropping seconds and the zone suffix. An invalid date returns the original string.

outputs.name: plural
outputs.description: Count and word joined with a space, with s appended unless the count is exactly 1. Irregular plural forms are not handled.

outputs.name: activityDisplay
outputs.description: When working is null, reports that no agent has registered and the count is unknown. Otherwise reports registered agent or agents working now, uses singular only for one, and excludes unregistered agents.
examples: No agent has registered in this repository, so who is working is not known.
registered agent is working now. Agents that do not register are not counted.
registered agents are working now. Agents that do not register are not counted.
